messages:
andrew: dropped a new draft with updated benchmark chart and two hero copy variants. planning A/B test on headline. need quick passes from design + legal by tomorrow AM.
nina: saw both variants. i prefer Variant B for tone: 'Predictable LLM performance at scale' vs Variant A 'Low-latency LLMs for product teams'. B aligns with platform thesis.
design: re: chart — can we simplify legend? reviewers get confused with too many lines. suggest keep only 'Redwood (quantized)' and 'Open baseline' and move other lines to appendix screenshot. also need 1200x628 hero image and mobile crop.
jake: technical note: the chart numbers are median p95 latency across 1k requests. callout copy should say 'p95 latency' not 'latency'. small but important.
andrew: good catch. update copy to 'p95 latency'. also let's include a short methodology link under the chart.
priya: HubSpot landing form ready. do we want a separate hidden field for experiment variant so we can segment A/B traffic?
andrew: yes add `experiment=hero_variant` param. good for conversion analysis.
mike: social snippets ready. one thread for X, one for LinkedIn. keeping the claim conservative: 'See how our serving runtime reduces p95 latency vs open-baseline in our benchmarks.'
legal: reviewing the benchmark wording. need a sentence: 'Benchmarks performed internally on representative workloads; results may vary.' Also request that we avoid percent claims without CI. any percent drop mentioned?
andrew: draft uses 'up to 35% lower p95' — i'll remove percent and change to 'lower p95'. we'll add methodology appendix with raw numbers and environment specs.
nina: UX suggestion 14 add alt text for hero: 'Screenshot of Redwood benchmark chart showing lower p95 latency vs baseline'. design pls.
design: noted, will add alt text and provide image variants.
jake: analytics: capture `hero_variant` in GA as `dimension1` and track CTA clicks with `eventCategory: 'Launch Blog'`. also set experiment id param on the A/B test.
priya: mapping: create two lists 'LP-variantA' and 'LP-variantB' so marketing can see conversion per variant in HubSpot. i'll tag leads with `hero_variant=A|B`.
andrew: embargo? can legal confirm embargo window? marketing-bot shows schedule 2026-03-25 09:00 PT but comms wants 12:00 PT to coordinate exec posts.
legal: embargo to 12:00 PT is fine, please lock content and mark as embargoed in cms. also send me screenshot of claims page for signoff.
marketing-bot: Reminder: set CMS status = 'Embargoed' and add 'Legal signoff completed' tag once done.
mike: creative ask 14 can design give an optional static GIF of chart morphing? might work well on social.
design: can do a simple morph GIF, but need final chart vector by EOD.
andrew: final actions: andrew 14 update copy to p95 + remove percent; design 14 finalize image variants + alt text + GIF mock; priya 14 add experiment field + lists; jake 14 GA dimension + event names; legal 14 embargo signoff by 10:30AM tomorrow.
nina: i'll prep social copy matrix + schedule.
marketing-bot: Reactions: :eyes: 5, :white_check_mark: 3 — moving to lock state for editorial review.
